latest_release.body:
## Improvements

- Aligned route icons with their labels on the context card.

### Install

Download from [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai), or `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`. An installed magpie updates itself.

- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `magpie-darwin-arm64.dmg`
- **macOS (Intel):** `magpie-darwin-amd64.dmg`
- **Windows:** `magpie-windows-amd64.exe` (ARM: `magpie-windows-arm64.exe`)
- **Linux:** `magpie-linux-amd64` / `magpie-linux-arm64` (needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1)
- **Terminal only:** `magpie-cli-<os>-<arch>`

<!-- lang:zh -->

## 改进

- 对齐了路线图标与上下文卡片上的标签。

### 安装

从 [usemagpie.ai](https://usemagpie.ai) 下载，或运行 `curl -fsSL https://usemagpie.ai/install.sh | sh`。已安装的 magpie 会自动更新。



---
The same release, and the feed magpie updates from: https://github.com/yetone/magpie-releases/releases/tag/v0.1.3343

# magpie ### Every agent's model. One place. **Claude Code on Kimi. Codex on DeepSeek. Gemini CLI on GLM. OpenCode on your ChatGPT plan.**
Switch any of them from the menu bar. One local gateway serves them all,
and when a quota runs out, it quietly moves on to your next account.
